metadata.comment: GENERATED SEED, then yours to edit. The English here was produced by library/modules/dbt-lesson/build.mjs from src/kit.js's COMMON/COPY/TL_COPY — the one place English is written (TASK-L160 §2, corrected). Editing a value here overrides what the kit ships for that key; deleting the node entirely makes every node fall back to its built-in English, which is why L160 AC1 renders byte-identically with nothing wired.

nodes.label: EDIT — this template's own page copy

metadata.comment: AUTHORED, and the only place these 19 strings are written (TASK-L161 §0b). The node above is GENERATED from the lesson kit and holds its 80. The two are merged below and a key written in both is reported to the console rather than silently resolved — so they cannot drift. Kit strings do not belong here; page copy does not belong in kit.js.

nodes.label: Merge the two halves, hand them out

metadata.comment: One calculation, one code node. `copy` is the WHOLE bundle and is what every kit node's Copy input takes — one wire, never 80 string parameters. The per-namespace outputs exist for Language Bundle, which registers one namespace at a time. Static Data may hand rows as runtime Models rather than plain objects, so plain() unwraps whichever arrives (the Data/Fixture lesson precedent).
Driven from the ONE owner — the `i18next` node in App. Nothing else in this template decides which language a page is in (TASK-L162 §1).

nodes.label: EDIT — a second locale goes here

metadata.comment: THE LOCALE OVERLAY, and it ships EMPTY. English lives in the two nodes beside it; a locale is an overlay ON TOP of English, so an untranslated key renders English by construction rather than by a fallback rule somebody has to remember. TASK-L162 §2.

nodes.label: Resolve it against what we actually have

metadata.comment: Two jobs, and the second is easy to miss. It refuses a language we have only the NAME of (the module's own detector can hand us "fr" on a French laptop one tick after load), and being strictly UPSTREAM of the merge it guarantees `Language Bundle.Language` is set before the `Bundle` JSON arrives — that node reads its Language only at the moment Bundle changes. TASK-L162 §1.
